 Bournemouth vs. AC Milan: Live updates and commentary from the Europa League clash 
 By Isak Möller - 22 October 2026, 20:15 
 AC Milan will be looking to catch up with tonight’s opponents, Bournemouth, who are currently three points ahead in the Europa League standings. Join us for the live commentary and updates from Vitality Stadium.

 Amorim's pre-match comments Cisse at No.9. Do you think he has the right characteristics to play there? 
 “Yes, he will play as a striker because he has exactly the characteristics we are looking for in this specific match. It won’t be easy for their central defenders to mark him or keep him under control.
 “He’s a very young player, with enormous room for growth, and he turns twenty today. We have enormous faith in him.”
 Why didn’t start Camarda up front? 
 “They have different characteristics. I analysed Bournemouth’s centre-backs and I believe Cisse has the right qualities to break them down. He had also already played this role with Italy’s U21S, so for me, he’s the right choice for this specific match. Simply that,” he said to Sky .
 2026-10-22 20:45:26 
 Hutchinson's pre-match comments What are your feelings? 
 “It’ll be a tough match, but I can’t wait for it to start, and I think everyone in the team shares that feeling. Many of the new arrivals have never experienced an atmosphere like this, so we have to guide them and be ready straight away.
 “It’s wonderful to be back in England. My whole family will be there tonight, and that’s an added bonus. It will be a fantastic match,” Hutchinson told Sky .

 Bournemouth vs. Milan: Official XIs Ruben Amorim has switched things around for this one, as we have become used to in the Europa League, with six changes to the starting eleven . Fikayo Tomori is making his second start of the season, while Alphadjo Cisse is playing up front.  
 Official Milan XI (4-2-3-1):  Maignan; Tomori, De Winter, Pavlovic, Estupinan; Musah, Jashari; Hutchinson, Loftus-Cheek, Moreira; Cisse.
 Bench:  Bouyer, Torriani, Gila, Diawara, Vladimirov, Bartesaghi, Modric, Rabiot, Comotto, Pulisic, Camarda.
 Official Bournemouth XI (4-2-3-1):  Di Gregorio; Hill, Diakité, Silva, Truffert; Christie, Adams; Tavernier, Kluivert, Gannon-Doak; Evanilson.
 Bench:  Petrovic, Allan, Cook, Julio Soler, Brooks, Smith, Adli, Toth, Rodriguez, Rayan.
